---
title: "Map"
---

```{r}
#| message: false
library(tidyverse)
library(maps)
```

```{r}
#| cache: true
attacks <- read_csv("data/attacks_clean.csv") |>
  mutate(
    Country_lower = Country |>
      str_trim() |>
      str_to_lower(),
    Fatal_clean = case_when(
      Fatal == "Y" ~ "Fatal",
      Fatal == "N" ~ "Non-fatal",
      TRUE ~ "Unknown"
    )
  )
write_rds(attacks, "data/attacks.rds")
```

```{r}
map_data("world") |>
  mutate(Country_lower = str_to_lower(region)) |>
  left_join(
    attacks |> count(Country_lower, name = "attacks"),
    by = "Country_lower"
  ) |>
  ggplot(aes(long, lat, group = group, fill = attacks)) +
  geom_polygon(color = "white", linewidth = 0.1) +
  coord_fixed() +
  scale_fill_viridis_c(na.value = "grey90") +
  labs(fill = "Shark attacks")
```

```{r}
attacks |>
  mutate(fatality = case_when(
    Fatal == "Y" ~ "Fatal",
    Fatal == "N" ~ "Non-fatal",
    TRUE ~ "Unknown/other"
  )) |>
  count(fatality)
```
